column3: Close to the Hebrew.
“Take full vengeance” renders “avenge the vengeance,” and “to your people” renders “to your peoples (kinsmen).”
“Arm” renders “be equipped,” and “go against” renders “be on.”
“A thousand from each tribe” renders “a thousand to the tribe, a thousand to the tribe.”
“there were furnished” renders “there were selected (delivered).”
“the holy vessels” renders “the vessels of the holy place,” and “the alarm” renders “teru’ah.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“the rest of their slain” renders “their slain.”
“their flocks” renders “their livestock (miqneh),” and “their cattle” renders “their beasts.”
“their camps” renders “their encampments (tirot).”
Close to the Hebrew.
“opposite Jericho” renders “of Jericho.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“from service in the war” renders “from the army of the battle.”
“all the women” renders “every female.”
“through the counsel of” renders “by the word of,” and “to trespass” renders “to commit unfaithfulness (ma’al).”
“who has known man intimately” renders “who has known a man by the lying of a male” (also in verses 18 and 35).
“all the girls” renders “all the little ones among the women.”
“any person” renders “a soul (nefesh),” and “purify yourselves” renders “cleanse yourselves from sin” (also in verse 20).

“that can stand the fire” renders “that will go into the fire,” and “water for impurity” renders “water of niddah (impurity).”

“the warriors” renders “those skilled in battle.”
